title: Web search providers: tavily, openai, perplexity, gemini, bedrock behind one interface with a configured fallback chain
description:
Ryan, 2026-11-01: build out search support for all those options. Tavily fails on billing (HTTP 432), so Papyrus must support several web-search providers behind one interface and switch or fall back by configuration alone.

Scope: papyrus_content.web_search (stdlib) with tavily, openai (Responses web_search), perplexity (Search API), gemini (Google Search grounding), bedrock (Web Search on Amazon Bedrock). WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDERS ordered chain, per-monitor searchProviders override, keys from <PROVIDER>_API_KEY or SSM /papyrus/search/<provider>-api-key. Billing, quota and auth failures fall through and are named in the monitor log. Opt-in infra parameters. Deep research is a separate follow-up.
